tools.name: render_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to preview or generate a chart from a Szum config after preflighting a generated or materially changed config with validate_chart. Stores a one-hour preview and returns a public image URL; authenticated calls use the account's render allowance.

tools.name: save_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to permanently save and publish a chart from a Szum config. Returns permanent public Image and Embed URLs plus Edit and Studio links; requires authentication and saved-chart storage.

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find charts in their saved library. Returns paginated metadata and URLs, not chart configs; requires authentication. Draft-only editor charts have publishedAt null, hasDraft true, and sizeBytes 0 because sizeBytes measures only the stored published config, not draft s

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and wants to view it or retrieve its metadata and URLs. Displays the published chart when available and does not return its config; requires authentication.

tools.name: get_chart_config
tools.description: Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and needs its complete published Szum config for inspection or reuse. Does not return a newer editor draft; requires authentication.

tools.name: get_preview_state
tools.description: Use this when the Szum chart App needs to restore a rendered preview as its current transient or saved view. It is read-only, owner-scoped when authenticated, and hidden from the model.

tools.name: update_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to replace and publish a saved chart's config while keeping its id and URLs. Refuses charts with unpublished editor changes; requires authentication and saved-chart storage.

tools.name: rename_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a saved chart's library title without changing its config, publication state, or public URLs; requires authentication.

tools.name: delete_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to permanently delete one saved chart. Deletion cannot be undone, and retrying an already completed deletion succeeds; requires authentication.

tools.name: validate_chart
tools.description: Use this when preflighting the first render, save, or update of a generated or materially changed Szum config, or when the user asks to validate or debug one. Read-only.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Use this when choosing a visual theme for a chart. Returns every available theme and guidance on where each works best.

tools.name: list_marks
tools.description: Use this when choosing or configuring chart mark types. Returns every available mark with its properties and defaults.

tools.name: get_examples
tools.description: Use this when the model needs current, ready-to-use Szum chart configs or preferred semantic patterns. Optionally filters examples by mark type.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_charts, get_chart · Public sink: save_chart, update_chart · Destructive: delete_chart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_charts, get_chart · Public sink: save_chart, update_chart · Destructive: delete_chart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "render_chart" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Render and validate a chart config, store it for 10 minutes, and return a public image URL. A fetched image may remain cached for up to 1 hour. Authenticated calls use the account's render allowance." → after: "Use this when the user wants to preview or generate a chart from a Szum config after preflighting a generated or materially changed config with validate_chart. Stores a one-hour preview and returns a public image URL; authenticated calls use the account's render allowance."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
